summary: Montreal, Canada, software engineering student, web developer, entrepreneur, bilingual (French/English), strong interest in startups and programming, experience with PHP and Ruby on Rails, interest in NoSQL databases, engaged in online communities like Hacker News and StackOverflow, has lived in Shenzhen, China, advocates for open web technologies, critical of corporate practices, interested in user experience design, has a background in self-directed learning, and has a strong belief in the value of networking and connections in education.
